scope: Delta re-audit of ru/ui.library at the current on-disk bytes, after ui.library.librarian.organize_now was shortened from «Упорядочить сейчас» to «Упорядочить» to clear a measured 40px librarian-row overflow. Judged in the librarian action row: the label sits beside «Библиотекарь», the last-organized/never-run state, the unorganized count, and an «Открыть» button.
judgement: The bare infinitive «Упорядочить» is adequate and idiomatic for the action: Russian UI buttons standardly use the infinitive, the row's own vocabulary («Упорядочено {at}», «не упорядочено») fixes the meaning, and «сейчас» adds no information next to a control that is by definition immediate. No clarity loss; no finding.
